original.reason: The construction never ensures that the diameters of the balls tend to zero; this is merely asserted. Thus completeness/nested-ball reasoning cannot be applied as written.

judgment.reason: It constructs nested nonempty closed balls with diameters tending to zero and gives a complete Cauchy-sequence proof that their intersection is nonempty.
The recursive construction and nested closed-set argument correctly yield a point outside every complement.
It correctly imposes shrinking diameters and cumulative avoidance of the closed complements.
The nested closed balls have diameters tending to zero and are placed successively inside the required dense open sets.
